principle: Use the smallest validated context set that can answer the task.
base_project_files: Use the platform upload manifest; do not add raw VNSTOCK data.

screening.notes: Use pass/fail/unknown; split into smaller batches if platform limits require.

refresh_rule: Replace task context when fingerprints, generated_at or rebuild decision changes.
limitations: No universal token/file limit is assumed; verify the current platform/account limit before upload.

provenance.source: Phase 6 batch cap, Phase 7 fingerprints, Phase 10 safety audit
